D5/S0/Tower/DBonacci/Names.dbonacci_name.name: D5.S0.Tower.DBonacci.Names.dbonacci_name_card
D5/S0/Tower/DBonacci/Names.dbonacci_name.signature: theorem dbonacci_name_card (d Q : Nat) : Fintype.card (DBonacciName d Q) = dbonacci d (Q + 2)

D5/S0/Tower/DBonacci/Names.dbonacci_name.name: D5.S0.Tower.DBonacci.Names.dbonacci_name_card_of_lt
D5/S0/Tower/DBonacci/Names.dbonacci_name.signature: theorem dbonacci_name_card_of_lt (d Q : Nat) (hlength : Q < d) : Fintype.card (DBonacciName d Q) = 2 ^ Q
